::: {#exm-venn-diagram}
#### Letters of two words

Let $L$ be the set of letters in the word LOGIC,
and $M$ the set of letters in the word MAGIC,
inside the set $S$ of the 26 letters of the alphabet.
@fig-venn-letters draws them.

::: {#fig-venn-letters}

![](../images/venn-letters.png){fig-alt="A Venn diagram: inside a rectangle labelled S, circle L holds L and O, circle M holds M and A, and their shaded overlap holds G, I and C." width="60%"}

The letters of LOGIC ($L$) and of MAGIC ($M$), with $L \cap M$ shaded.

:::

- The shaded region, inside both circles, is $L \cap M = \set{\text{G}, \text{I}, \text{C}}$.
- The part of circle $L$ outside circle $M$ is $L \setminus M = \set{\text{L}, \text{O}}$.
- Everything inside either circle is $L \cup M = \set{\text{L}, \text{O}, \text{G}, \text{I}, \text{C}, \text{M}, \text{A}}$.
- Everything in the rectangle outside circle $L$ is $L^c$, the 21 letters not in LOGIC.

:::
